campaigns.context: Large ClickFix/ClearFake wave on newly registered .beer and .sbs domains with script-themed names such as bootstrap-maxcdn.beer and capcha-cdn-js.beer. campaigns.name: ClearFake/ClickFix fake CAPTCHA lures on .beer and .sbs domains

campaigns.context: Android malware impersonating Rakuten spreads via lookalike domains, including a ruceive* prefix with point-app naming such as ruceive1-rakntanpointapp.com and a raku-point-[word].com pattern such as raku-point-ankanz.com and raku-point-style.com. Enrichment cites a VirusTotal sample for the raku-point group, and one summary names Amazon. One reporter (masaomi346) flagged these from 2026-09-05 to 2026-09-11.
campaigns.name: Rakuten Android malware on point-app lookalike domains

campaigns.context: Magecart web-skimming infrastructure uses domains that imitate analytics, CDN and security services, such as doubleclickpro.com, feedback-hotjar.com and captchatimestamp.com. Enrichment cites a shared /skimmer.js path and two backend IPs on port 8888. Two reporters flagged 52 IOCs from 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-26.
campaigns.name: Magecart skimmer infrastructure on fake analytics/CDN domains

campaigns.context: Adobe-themed phishing pages on attacker-registered domains and screenconnect.com tenant subdomains deliver ScreenConnect RMM client installers via /Bin/ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.msi and .exe paths. campaigns.name: Adobe-themed phishing delivering ScreenConnect RMM installer

campaigns.context: Android malware spreads via randomly-named .com domains sharing a scrambled-letter naming style, such as poiwaksuwa.com, oiuwaksdiw.com, poiwaldsas.com, hasoadwaznqps.com, puwaiosd.com and jzqixing.com. campaigns.context: Japanese-language emails impersonating tax authorities route victims through random-label domains on .shop, .cyou, .top and .com: rrrjp.shop, pfokq.cyou, vjtpcxof.top, wecqb.cyou and thkiind.com. campaigns.context: Enrichment describes malicious WordPress JavaScript injection infrastructure on wp-js.com subdomains such as stats, static, js, files and cdn, plus relay domains, with zero VirusTotal detections at report time. One reporter (500mk500) flagged 12 IOCs on 2026-09-16.

campaigns.context: third-party.com hosts a fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA ClickFix lure that copies a malicious PowerShell command to the clipboard. Enrichment says the domain is hardcoded in over 1,700 GitHub repositories, which widens its potential victim pool. Six reporters flagged 11 IOCs from 2026-09-23 to 2026-09-29.
campaigns.name: ClickFix CAPTCHA lure hardcoded into 1700+ GitHub repos

campaigns.context: Enrichment ties norahadraivnig.com to phishing emails impersonating the ClearChoice dental brand with hidden-character subject lines, and to a se. subdomain with a fake vehicle protection discount lure. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 10 IOCs from 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-21.
campaigns.name: ClearChoice-themed phishing emails from norahadraivnig.com

campaigns.context: The domain get-verification.to hosts a ClickFix fake verification page, tagged #ClickFix and #malware, that leads victims to run a PowerShell iex(irm) command fetching a payload from imacos.cc, which serves /captcha/ paths with random identifiers. Enrichment notes it had not been taken down by the registrar at the time of reporting. Several reporters flagged 10 IOCs from 2026-09-18 to 2026-10-01.
campaigns.name: ClickFix verification lure at get-verification.to

campaigns.context: MioLab is a macOS infostealer distributed disguised as an Easy Data Transform 2.11.0 installer, with C2 at lewokodwqko.icu. The grouping comes from enrichment of related samples; there is no wider domain-naming pattern. Two reporters flagged 10 IOCs from 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-29.
campaigns.name: MioLab macOS infostealer C2 at lewokodwqko.icu

campaigns.context: Four lookalike domains impersonate OpenAI with credits and bonus themes: openai-credit.com, openai-credits.com, openai-bonus.com and openaaii.com. They carry #ClickFix and #malware tags. Two reporters flagged 9 IOCs on 2026-10-02.
campaigns.name: OpenAI credits/bonus typosquats with ClickFix tag

campaigns.context: UNC6671 infrastructure uses the root domain ssosettings.com with hostnames spoofing legitimate organizations, including slaughterandmay.ssosettings.com impersonating a UK law firm and insigniafinancial.ssosettings.com. campaigns.name: MEDVi-branded phishing email via stylishhomegallery.com
